title: Point-in-Time Correct Feature Join
hints: Each feature has its own cutoff: as_of = event_ts - lag. A snapshot is visible only if both its ts and its created_at are <= as_of.
Among the visible rows for (entity, feature), take the greatest ts, then the greatest version. Don't scan every snapshot for every label: group them by (entity, feature) first.
TTL is measured from as_of, not from event_ts: age = as_of - ts. A stale latest row is expired. Don't fall back to an older row, which would be even staler.
created_at is what keeps a backfill from leaking. A row computed today for last month's ts was not in the store when last month's prediction was made.
